name: claude-bot-bridge
description: Talk to external AI bots from Claude Desktop over a webhook, and read the replies back.
long_description: Send a message to any bot that accepts an HTTP webhook. Replies can come back in the HTTP response, from a URL Claude polls, from an SSE stream the bot hosts, or from a local inbox. No JSON editing: the install form asks for the webhook URL and secret.

webhook_url.title: Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: https endpoint that receives messages from Claude.

webhook_key.title: Webhook secret
webhook_key.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Leave blank if the bot does not check a key.

reply_url.title: Reply URL
reply_url.description: Optional GET URL the bot updates with replies. Leave blank to use the webhook response or SSE.

reply_sse_url.title: Reply SSE URL
reply_sse_url.description: Optional Server-Sent Events URL the bot hosts. The bridge connects out, so the bot needs no public callback.

signing_secret.title: HMAC signing secret
signing_secret.description: Optional. Signs each webhook body as X-Bridge-Signature.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to one bot.

tools.name: wait_for_reply
tools.description: Wait until a new reply arrives.

tools.name: broadcast_message
tools.description: Send one message to several bots.

tools.name: relay_conversation
tools.description: Run a bounded conversation between two bots.

tools.name: stop_relay
tools.description: Stop a running relay between turns.
